race.comment: HYDE PARK (8) has attracted support at his past couple of starts, and though beaten, he has not been far off the placings. He slides down in class, and he has a great chance to upgrade his modest track stats. OUR MISSILE (11) is backing up quickly after a solid third at a Middlemount picnic meeting just 7 days ago and he is capable at this level. He carries a kilo less this time, and he can figure in the top 3 again. TAMBO'S JUSTICE (5) resumed from a spell with a runner-up finish here last start and he has never missed a cheque second-up in the past. He has the pole position, loves it here, and is set to go one better. LINE 'EM UP LOUI (10) is racing in outstanding form with 4 wins and 2 placings from 7 starts this prep. He drops 7.5kg, and from another good gate, the hat-trick beckons. MAXIMUM POWER (13) has plenty of ability when his mind is on the job, and a quick backup should not be a problem with him being so deep into his prep. Stick with him.
